## Scope and resolution

Root binding.json is the sole immutable destination authority; item manifests, initialized.json, HTTP schemas, request fingerprints and Backend DB contracts are unchanged.
Canonical origin grammar/bytes, explicit locked no-overwrite init, precise pristine inventory, temp-only crash recovery, missing/corrupt/mismatch zero-HTTP/zero-item-mutation failure, startup/send/all-state-write/ACK recovery checks and v1 no-migration are explicit.
Only contract sections 7/8/9/10 and document revision header changed; related three architecture links say revision2. Sections1..6 are byte-preserved.
Reviewer counterexample A (A spool restarted under B with PENDING/RETRY_WAIT/IN_FLIGHT): startup binding comparison halts before any attempt/network/state write.
Counterexample B (A ACKED then restart under B): binding check runs before any no-network ACK recovery/move/finalization; ACK stays attached to old spool.
Crash before binding final publication authorizes no producer/HTTP. Explicit init may recreate ONLY exact owned temp on pristine inventory. Complete final wins; corrupt final or nonempty missing final never reconstructed from config/temp.
Destination in-place changes even on an emptied bound spool are prohibited; new server means separate pristine spool/new intents, never cross-server ACK migration.

### Bounded origin/init/counterexample reference
```javascript
const assert=require('assert'),net=require('net');
function canon(s){
 if(typeof s!=='string'||/[^\x21-\x7e]|[\\%@?#]/.test(s))throw Error('chars');
 const m=/^(https?):\/\/(\[[0-9a-fA-F:]+\]|[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)(?::([0-9]+))?\/?$/i.exec(s);
 if(!m)throw Error('grammar');
 const scheme=m[1].toLowerCase();let host=m[2],port=m[3];
 if(port&&(!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(port)||+port>65535))throw Error('port');
 if(host.startsWith('[')){
  if(net.isIP(host.slice(1,-1))!==6)throw Error('ipv6');
  host=new URL(scheme+'://'+host).hostname;
 }else if(/^[0-9.]+$/.test(host)){
  const parts=host.split('.');
  if(parts.length!==4||parts.some(p=>! /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$/.test(p)||+p>255))throw Error('ipv4');
 }else{
  const labels=host.split('.'),last=labels.at(-1);
  if(host.length>253||labels.some(l=>/^xn--/i.test(l)||l.length>63||! /^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?$/.test(l))||!/[a-z]/i.test(last)||/^0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(last))throw Error('dns');
  host=host.toLowerCase();
 }
 if(port=== (scheme==='http'?'80':'443'))port=undefined;
 return scheme+'://'+host+(port?':'+port:'');
}
const valid=[
 ['HTTP://LOCALHOST:80/','http://localhost'],
 ['https://Example.COM:443','https://example.com'],
 ['http://127.0.0.1:8001/','http://127.0.0.1:8001'],
 ['http://[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:8001/','http://[::1]:8001'],
 ['http://[2001:0DB8:0:0:1:0:0:1]','http://[2001:db8::1:0:0:1]'],
 ['http://localhost:65535','http://localhost:65535'],
 ['https://example.com:80','https://example.com:80'],
 ['http://[::]','http://[::]'],
 ['http://'+'a'.repeat(63)+'.com','http://'+'a'.repeat(63)+'.com'],
 ['http://'+'a'.repeat(63)+'.'+'b'.repeat(63)+'.'+'c'.repeat(63)+'.'+'d'.repeat(61),'http://'+'a'.repeat(63)+'.'+'b'.repeat(63)+'.'+'c'.repeat(63)+'.'+'d'.repeat(61)]
];
const invalid=[' http://host','http://host ','http://host\n','http://host/path','http://host//','http://host?','http://host#','http://user@host','http://host\\evil','http://%68ost','http://host:','http://host:080','http://host:0','http://host:65536','http://127.1','http://0177.0.0.1','http://2130706433','http://0x7f000001','http://host.','http://host..com','http://host.123','http://host.0x10','http://[fe80::1%25eth0]','http://::1','http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]','ftp://host','http://-host','http://host_1','http://'+String.fromCodePoint(0xD55C)+'.com','http://xn--bcher-kva.de','http://a-.example','http://127.0.0.01','http://256.0.0.1','http://0X7F','http://[host]','http://[v1.abc]','http://host:+80','http://'+'a'.repeat(64)+'.com','http://'+'a'.repeat(63)+'.'+'b'.repeat(63)+'.'+'c'.repeat(63)+'.'+'d'.repeat(62)];
for(const [s,e] of valid)assert.equal(canon(s),e);
for(const s of invalid)assert.throws(()=>canon(s),undefined,s);
assert.notEqual(canon('http://localhost:8001'),canon('http://127.0.0.1:8001'));
assert.notEqual(canon('http://[::1]:8001'),canon('http://127.0.0.1:8001'));
function init({final='absent',same=true,pristine=true,temp=false,explicit=true,lock=true,safe=true}={}){
 if(!lock||!safe)return 'HALT';
 if(final==='invalid')return 'HALT';
 if(final==='valid')return same?'KEEP':'HALT';
 if(!explicit||!pristine)return 'HALT';
 return temp?'RECREATE_TEMP_AND_PUBLISH':'PUBLISH';
}
assert.equal(init(),'PUBLISH');
assert.equal(init({temp:true}),'RECREATE_TEMP_AND_PUBLISH');
assert.equal(init({temp:true,explicit:false}),'HALT');
assert.equal(init({pristine:false}),'HALT'); // includes empty item dir, image-only, ACKED.
assert.equal(init({final:'invalid',temp:true}),'HALT');
assert.equal(init({final:'valid',same:false}),'HALT'); // empty too: immutable.
assert.equal(init({final:'valid',temp:true,pristine:false}),'KEEP');
assert.equal(init({lock:false}),'HALT');
assert.equal(init({safe:false}),'HALT');
// Concrete counterexample models: model only, no product IO.
function advance(item, disk, configured, stage){
 const result={item:structuredClone(item),http:0,moves:0};
 if(disk!==configured){result.halt=true;return result;}
 if(stage==='send'){result.item.state='IN_FLIGHT';result.item.attempt++;result.http++;}
 if(stage==='recover-ack'){result.item.state='UPLOADED';result.moves++;}
 return result;
}
for(const state of ['PENDING','RETRY_WAIT','IN_FLIGHT','ACKED','UPLOADED']){
 const item={state,attempt:3,ack:state==='ACKED'||state==='UPLOADED'?{serverReceipt:'A'}:null};
 const blocked=advance(item,'http://server-a:8001','http://server-b:8001',state==='ACKED'?'recover-ack':'send');
 assert.deepEqual(blocked.item,item);assert.equal(blocked.http,0);assert.equal(blocked.moves,0);assert(blocked.halt);
}
const same=advance({state:'ACKED',attempt:3,ack:{serverReceipt:'A'}},'http://server-a:8001','http://server-a:8001','recover-ack');
assert.equal(same.item.state,'UPLOADED');assert.equal(same.http,0);assert.equal(same.moves,1);
const configured=canon('http://localhost:8001'),bound=configured;
for(const stage of ['startup','before-attempt','before-ACKED','before-move','recovery','requeue','before-RETRY_WAIT','before-FAILED','before-state-init']){
 for(const disk of [null,'corrupt','http://localhost:8002']){
  const unchanged={attempt:3,ack:'old',location:'pending'};
  const snapshot=JSON.stringify(unchanged);
  const allowed=disk===bound&&configured===bound;
  assert.equal(allowed,false,stage); assert.equal(JSON.stringify(unchanged),snapshot);
 }
}
console.log('PASS bounded reference: '+valid.length+' accepted normalization vectors, '+invalid.length+' rejection vectors, aliases distinct, 9 init decisions, 27 binding-failure stage decisions; 5 A-to-B state counterexamples and same-origin ACK recovery.');
console.log('NOT_RUN: actual queue/filesystem crash/concurrency/HTTP tests; this is specification reference validation only.');
```

```javascript
const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),crypto=require('crypto'),assert=require('assert');

const snaps=[...report.matchAll(/### Snapshot: ([^\r\n]+)\r?\nSHA256: ([a-f0-9]+)\r?\nBASE64_BEGIN\r?\n([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)\r?\nBASE64_END/g)];
assert.equal(snaps.length,4);
for(const [,n,h,b64] of snaps){
 const old=Buffer.from(b64,'base64');assert.equal(hash(old),h);

 if(n==='phase-2-upload-contract.md'){
  const before=old.toString('utf8').split('## 7. Producer')[0].replace('Document revision: 1.','Document revision: 2.');
  assert.equal(cur.split('## 7. Producer')[0],before,'sections1..6 preserved');
 }else assert.equal(cur,old.toString('utf8').replaceAll('P2-UPLOAD-v1 revision 1','P2-UPLOAD-v1 revision 2'));
}

 assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync('.orchestration/'+n+'/ARCH-UPLOAD-001-02.md')),h,'old evidence retained');
}
let links=0,json=0;
for(const [,n] of snaps){
 const file='docs/architecture/'+n,c=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');
 assert.equal((c.match(/\x60\x60\x60/g)||[]).length%2,0);
 for(const m of c.matchAll(/\]\(([^)]+)\)/g)){
  if(!m[1].includes('://')&&!m[1].startsWith('#')){assert(fs.existsSync(p.resolve(p.dirname(file),m[1].split('#')[0])),m[1]);links++;}
 }

 console.log(n+' SHA256 '+hash(fs.readFileSync(file)));
}
```
